inference: Facts only. Together with the bipod-chain-diff note: the weapons whose GS bind the selector under the deployed-recoil modifier alone (list B) are the ones the site repo's bug entry 25 lists for the missing mounted spread benefits (Mk 24, EF88, Z84M, VSSM; BROD 3 for the grip pods), plus shotguns and SMGs that do not offer a bipod.
unresolved: The 18 list B weapons include several (SMGs, shotguns, Devgru) with no bipod choice on the site, so list B membership alone does not name a mismatch.
Runtime activation of any binding is not shown.
